name: Bioclimatic zonification from PCI
abstract: Classifies the continuous PCI raster into categorical bioclimatic zones (stable, mild advance, strong advance, delay) using published thresholds, then vectorises contiguous cells of the same class into a GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Each feature is enriched with statistics, the SKOS concept IRI for its category, and the KMGBF targets it informs.
